name: losus-ai
description: Mark Susol's personal Claude Code plugins — planning rules, a Kaggle competition harness, git/db guards, a DGX Spark host-facts rule set, and a usage status line.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Deploys planning-* rules to ~/.claude/rules/ and @-imports them in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: kaggle
plugins.description: Light harness for Kaggle competitions — kaggle-* rules, a project-scaffold skill, and /kaggle:new + /kaggle:preflight commands.

plugins.name: dgx-spark
plugins.description: Global dgx-spark-* rules for spark-db62 — Docker context/daemon gotchas and other host-level facts that apply across every project on the machine.

plugins.name: db-guard
plugins.description: Two-layer guard against unauthorized DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, DROP DATABASE, DROP SCHEMA, and DROP COLUMN.

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Three-layer protection against unauthorized git commit and git push, plus PreToolUse enforcement of the GitFlow (Lite) branch-naming convention.

plugins.name: usage-statusline
plugins.description: Status line showing model, context %, and subscription rate limits.

plugins.name: jira-tickets
plugins.description: The /jira-describe skill — drives a living Current Status + append-only History layout for Jira ticket descriptions, and flags which Atlassian tool path supports real Markdown/ADF rendering vs. a plain-text fallback.

plugins.name: scratch-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that blocks scratch/test scripts from being written as standalone files in a shared system temp directory outside a Claude Code session's own scratchpad.
